raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Transient GitHub API 502 responses in `check-pr-test-health` abort jobs before tests run and trigger dependent fail-fast failures.

## Modifications

Set the existing `actions/github-script@v8` health-check step to `retries: 3`, using its native retry handling. The health-gate JavaScript, inputs, and environment remain unchanged.

## Validation

- Required pre-commit checks passed.
- Verified the change adds exactly one YAML setting and preserves the health-check script byte for byte.
- Runtime tests were not run; this changes CI API retry handling only.

<!-- pr-states:start -->
---

<!-- pr-states:end -->
